Sheet Metal Worker
Employer Sponsorship Available | Perth, WA | Full-Time
MYAC Resources is currently seeking experienced Sheet Metal Workers to join our growing network of leading Australian employers across Perth, Western Australia.
We have multiple long-term opportunities available for skilled tradespeople who take pride in producing high-quality workmanship and want to build a secure, rewarding career with established Australian businesses. Whether you're already in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates. If you're motivated, reliable and passionate about fabrication, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Role
As a Sheet Metal Worker, you'll play a key role in the fabrication, assembly and repair of precision sheet metal components used across a variety of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.
Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you'll be part of a professional team delivering quality workmanship while maintaining the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Fabricating and assembling sheet metal components to specification 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings, technical plans and fabrication details 
• Cutting, folding, bending, rolling and shaping sheet metal 
• MIG and TIG welding where required 
• Operating fabrication equipment including press brakes, guillotines, rollers, punches and other workshop machinery 
• Measuring, marking and preparing materials for fabrication 
• Repairing, modifying and installing fabricated components 
• Conducting quality inspections to ensure finished products meet engineering specifications Maintaining workshop equipment and ensuring a clean, organised work environment 
• Working safely in accordance with all workplace health and safety procedures 

About You
To be successful in this role, you'll have:
• Trade qualification as a Sheet Metal Worker, Metal Fabricator or equivalent recognised trade qualification
• Previous experience in sheet metal fabrication 
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
• Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment 
• Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills 
• High attention to detail with pride in producing quality workmanship 
• Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment 
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills 
• Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards 

Highly Regarded
While not essential, the following experience will be highly regarded:
• MIG and TIG welding experience 
• Stainless steel and aluminium fabrication experience 
• Experience working in manufacturing, mining or heavy industrial environments 
• Forklift Licence 
• Overhead Crane experience 
• Current Australian Driver's Licence 
• Experience with precision fabrication and custom metalwork 

Employer Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine long-term employment opportunities across Australia for suitably qualified candidates, employer sponsorship is available, subject to employer approval and Australian migration requirements.
Whether you're already in Australia or planning to relocate, we can help connect you with employers seeking skilled Sheet Metal Workers.

What's on Offer
• Permanent full-time position 
• Perth, Western Australia location 
• Competitive salary package with overtime opportunities 
• Long-term career stability with established Australian employers 
• Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment 
• Ongoing training and career development 
• Supportive, safety-focused team environment 
• Employer sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
• Opportunity to build a long-term career in Australia 

Why Join MYAC Resources?
MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia's manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors. We don't just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our experienced recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed. If you're a skilled tradesperson who takes pride in quality workmanship and wants to work with reputable Australian employers, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.

If you're an experienced Sheetmetal worker looking for your next opportunity in Perth, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your resume to recruitment@myacresources.com.au
Apply today with your current resume and one of our recruitment specialists will be in touch

result.description:
Since 1981, Shadbolt Group has grown to become a leading cost-effective engineering solutions provider. We are proud of our professional performance on each and every project. Our aim is to build long term relationships with our clients based on trust, accountability and integrity. It is our dedication to quality that gives our clients a competitive advantage.

This goes hand in hand with our diligence and engineering excellence. From pipework projects to tank manufacturing, structural works, machine building or site work. Shadbolt Group is committed to providing prompt and precise delivery from our highly trained team of experts. The requirements of each client are always the focus of everything we do.

We are seeking qualified Pressure Welders to join our growing professional team. We seek reliable, team-oriented individuals with high integrity who will positively contribute to the company's success. We offer short-term contracts with above-award pay rates fully guaranteed under current workplace regulations.
Position available across our site and work locations in NSW, SA, WA and VIC.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to determine and perform appropriate welding techniques for the task at hand
Set up equipment and weld parts, using appropriate pressure welding equipment and methods
Examine welds for width of bead, penetration and precision, and performs necessary repairs or reworks
Weld and repair pressure vessels and pipes to relevant high-quality standards and ensure conformance with standard specifications
Fabricate metal components in accordance with supplied drawings and specifications
Conduct tests on welds to ensure there are no leaks in the pressurised systems
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Apply post-weld treatments to relieve stress and enhance the strength of the welded joints on pressure-containing equipment
Diagnose faults and perform operational maintenance on machines and equipment in order to restore full functionality and safety performance, maintaining a condition that does not compromise safety
Maintain tools and equipment to a professional standard
Keep the workstation clean and orderly to retain a safe and operational work environment
Clean and prepare metal surfaces for welding by flame cutting, heat cutting, gouging, bevelling, grinding or filing
Manage workflow, meet deadlines, and troubleshoot problems on a daily basis, in addition to fabrication duties

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:

result.description:
JBS Australia is the largest and most respected meat and food producer in Australia. We have a strong portfolio of leading and renowned beef, lamb, pork, salmon and value-added branded products, such as AMH, Swift, Primo, Murray Valley and Huon. JBS Australia is a part of the global JBS business, the largest animal protein business in the world, and the second largest food company, with operations in North America, South America, Europe, Australia and New Zealand.

The JBS Dinmore Processing Plant is the largest beef facility in the southern hemisphere. Located near Ipswich, in south east Queensland, the facility has a daily production ability of 3,400 cattle and employs approximately 2,600 people. Cattle are sourced from the finest cattle producing regions to produce a diverse range of pasture fed and grain beef products, from commodity to premium. The renowned AMH brand, the award-winning Yardstick, the highly marbled grain fed Pure Prime and our state’s brand, Queenslander Beef and more are all produced at Dinmore.

About the Role:
We are currently seeking a Mechanical Engineering Technician to join our Dinmore Plant. We are seeking a passionate and energetic individual who is committed to the position and providing an effective professional service. This is a fantastic opportunity to join our dynamic, exciting organization who are the leaders in safety and culture across Australia. Within the role you will enjoy the benefits and satisfaction in contributing to the continued growth and success of our business. This role will be responsible for providing maintenance support to all areas across the plant to ensure the attainment of Production, Quality/FSQA, and Workplace Health and Safety requirements and objectives. This is a full-time position with the annual salary more than $79,423 plus superannuation.

Your key responsibilities will include:
Conducts tests of mechanical systems, collects and analyses data, and assembles and installs mechanical assemblies in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
Ensuring maximum equipment uptime is achieved by providing effective and efficient mechanical preventative and breakdown maintenance
Engaging in fabrication, installation and repair of mechanical machines, instruments or appliances
Ensuring that all work is carried out to the Company and requirements and conforms to all relevant regulations
Utilising fault-finding to troubleshoot and rectify problems

About you
Previous experience in a fast-paced industrial manufacturing environment
Previous experience within the meat industry advantageous
Sound knowledge of pneumatics and hydraulics, as well as a basic knowledge of electrics and welding skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Demonstrated continuous improvement approach
Ability to support a broad variety of mechanical work
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Ability to communicate at all levels
Ability to work autonomously as well as in a team environment
Ability to work various shifts
Full Australian working rights

Why work for us:
Retail discounts with national partners
Health insurance discounts on Bupa Health and Medibank
Heavily discounted meat products

The ad is valid for 28 days.

What next? If you’re passionate and want to be a part of the largest meat, pork and salmon manufacturer and producer in Australia, this opportunity may be for you. Apply now!
